g.text: Paired comparisons preserve ties and uncertainty
2,000 bootstrap resamples of 30 complete paired conditional streams per cell. Diamonds flag degenerate intervals (for example every pair tied); they do not prove
equivalence or superiority. Full tables also retain the ordinary ≥50 comparison and all scopes. The finite source pools and small number of repeats limit
generalization; no natural detection-accuracy interval is claimed.
